Default markdown output format produces standard markdown

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<h1>Title</h1><p>Some text.</p>", "{\"heading_style\":\"Atx\",\"output_format\":\"Markdown\"}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
